variants.headline: Still in view: assembly votes the government out
variants.sub: The government has been voted out by the Colonial Assembly.
variants.body:
Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement. The Colonial Assembly has voted the government out in {colony}.

We take a sympathetic view of {target}. A parliamentary defeat is decisive for office, but it need not be treated as a final moral verdict on every person or position involved.

variants.headline: Still in view: confidence withdrawn
variants.sub: An Assembly vote has removed the government in {colony}.
variants.body:

variants.headline: Still in view: office meets its parliamentary limit
variants.sub: The Colonial Assembly has voted the government out in {colony}.
variants.body:
Our attention to this story continues after {months_running} months, with the original report still the starting point. An Assembly vote has removed the government in {colony}.
